description:
**Approval set for the first week of June. Additionally, this property will not qualify for traditional financing. Cash offers only. Investors are welcome.** Charming 3-bedroom, 1-bath home full of character throughout. Hardwood flooring runs through the living spaces and bedrooms, adding warmth and continuity. The kitchen features rich wood cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and classic brick accents that extend into the dining and kitchen areas for added texture and charm.

The inviting living room showcases a beautiful brick fireplace, creating a cozy focal point for the home. All bedrooms are generously sized, and the bathroom offers modern updates and convenient amenities.

Exit outside to a backyard designed for relaxation and entertaining, complete with a covered patio ideal for outdoor dining. The property also includes a covered in-ground jacuzzi, a detached garage, a gated driveway, and a grass swatch in the backyard for added greenery.

Don’t miss this opportunity—schedule your showing today.
